class.name: IfcPropertyReferenceValue
class.brief_description: IfcPropertyReferenceValue allows a property value to be given by referencing other entities within the resource definitions of IFC. Those other entities are regarded as predefined complex properties and can be aggregated within a property set ( IfcPropertySet ). The allowable entities to be used as value references are given by the IfcObjectReferenceSelect . HISTORY New entity in IFC Release 1.5.

members.member: Description of the use of the referenced value within the property.

Reference to another property entity through one of the select types in the IfcObjectReferenceSelect . IFC2x4 CHANGE The attribute has been made optional with upward compatibility for file based exchange.
